properties.description:
reflow2's founding vision, in the repository since the first commit (2026-07-17). It states the scope: "Capture the entire lifecycle — concept → operations — in one graph". It names the transitions where programs break (concept → design, design → build, build → operate, and late change reaching every phase) and the phases "concept, design, build, test, production, O&M". It defines good as "Someone with only an idea is guided — by questions — from concept to operations without needing to know systems engineering." README.md and AGENTS.md point to it as "the north star for everything below".

Registered 2026-09-28 because it had never been in the design. The graph held its scope only as the one line of req:coherence, and a triage that read the graph and not this file framed "should reflow2 serve a design in operations?" as an open question (fact:root-cause-the-lifecycle-scope-lives-in-the-vision-and-the-graph-holds-one-line-so-a-brainstorm-reopened-it-2026-09-28).
properties.name: docs/vision.md — the north star: one coherent graph from concept to operations
